description: SMPTE bars revealed left to right over a dark-grey bed by a track matte: a full-frame white rectangle with `origin` on its left edge whose `transform.scale.x` runs 0 to 1 over the first 30 frames, linearly. Frame 7 shows the bars' leftmost ~23% (about 30 of 128 columns) and the grey bed to the right of a sharp vertical edge; frame 15 the left half; frame 22 about 73%. The matte rectangle itself is never visible — no white anywhere. What a wrong render looks like: white where the bars should be means the matte clip was drawn on its own track as well as used as a mask; bars across the whole frame means the matte was ignored; the reveal growing from the centre means the matte's origin was lost; the bars' colours shifted or darkened inside the reveal means the mask scaled colour instead of coverage.
